name: lpc-toolkit
description: Compose characters and author attributed LPC assets with the installed CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Compose characters and author LPC assets
interface.longDescription: Guide Codex through three attributed workflows: compose a character from existing art, extend incomplete animations, or create new assets for supported LPC layouts.
defaultPrompt: Build an LPC character from existing catalog art, show an attributed preview, and help me refine it.
Find a catalog item with incomplete run animation support, show me the read-only evidence, and ask before starting an authoring revision.
Create a new attributed LPC asset for a supported layout and stop at a review-ready preview.
